name: Tune In To You
source:
Two people who were once best friends meet once more after a decade when one of them hears the other's voice over the radio, who is now the host of the channel.

Their eventual meetup leads to them playing old games on their old handheld consoles. But something happens, and now have to resolve problems from puzzles to each other's in order to escape.

[From [url=https://kemonito-kusuri.itch.io/tune-in-to-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个曾经是最好朋友的人十年后再次见面，其中一人在广播中听到了对方的声音，而对方现在是该频道的主持人。

他们最终的聚会导致他们在旧的手持游戏机上玩旧游戏。但发生了一些事情，现在必须解决彼此的困惑才能逃脱。

[来自[url=https://kemonito-kusuri.itch.io/tune-in-to-you]Itch.io[/url]]
